question: The Largest brackish water Lake of India is present in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __'**Odisha'.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brackish water** or briny water has more salinity than freshwater, but not as much as seawater. It may result from the mixing of seawater with fresh water, as in estuaries, or it may occur in brackish fossil aquifers.
 
• Bodies of water of **brackish lagoons**, marshes and deltas are lakes with an average salinity and a mixture of freshwater and seawater.
 
• The largest brackish water lake is present in **Odisha.**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The largest brackish water lake is named "**Chilika**".
 
• It is a shallow lagoon with estuarine character spread across the districts of **Puri, Khurda and Ganjam** in the state of Odisha in eastern India.
 
• Chilika Lake lives up to its reputation as the most picturesque spot and being **Asia's largest salt-water lagoon**.
